V_kCAFG_struct_factor = {
    value = var:factor
}

V_kCAFG_struct_inverted_factor = {
    value = 1
    subtract = var:factor
}

V_kCAFG_struct_amount = {
    value = var:factor
    multiply = V_kCAFG_province_values_scale
}

V_kCAFG_struct_factor_rounded = {
    value = V_kCAFG_struct_factor
    multiply = 100
    round = yes
    min = 1
    divide = 100
}

V_kCAFG_struct_amount_rounded = {
    value = V_kCAFG_struct_amount
    multiply = 100
    round = yes
    min = 1
    divide = 100
}

V_kCAFG_struct_tension_baseline_contribution = {
    value = var:factor
    multiply = var:tension_baseline
}

V_kCAFG_struct_opinion_value = {
    value = 0
    if = {
        limit = { has_variable = tension_baseline }
        if = {
            limit = { var:tension_baseline <= V_kCAFG_tension_baseline_contribution_opinion_threshold_very_good }
            value = 5
        }
        else_if = {
            limit = { var:tension_baseline <= V_kCAFG_tension_baseline_contribution_opinion_threshold_good }
            value = 4
        }
        else_if = {
            limit = { var:tension_baseline <= V_kCAFG_tension_baseline_contribution_opinion_threshold_medium }
            value = 3
        }
        else_if = {
            limit = { var:tension_baseline <= V_kCAFG_tension_baseline_contribution_opinion_threshold_bad }
            value = 2
        }
        else_if = {
            limit = { var:tension_baseline <= V_kCAFG_tension_baseline_contribution_opinion_threshold_very_bad }
            value = 1
        }
    }
}
